text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, for the announcement!
This year's Best Junior-tier Umamusume is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: I'm Furioso!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, congratulations! Well, it was to be expected!
Yeah, congratulations! Well, that's no surprise!

text_block_list.text:
――The NAU Grand Prix. Furioso was honored
by the National Association of Umamusume, or "NAU",
the regional equivalent of the URA.

The award for Best Regional Junior-Class Umamusume.
Everyone thought her victory was certain.
Because Furioso was—

She claimed a decisive victory in the GⅠ Zen-Nihon Nisai Yushun,
where Central Umamusume also competed.

Winning the only dirt GⅠ in the Junior Class
was undeniably huge.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Trainer.
They've acknowledged me as the number one Junior-class Umamusume in the local circuits.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: It really does... make one happy.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes. But rather than being acknowledged for who I truly am—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"'They recognized that my path was right.'
Perhaps that makes me even happier."
choice_data_list: Whether this path is the right one, huh...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Being on a special study abroad program at the URA,
I am, so to speak, a "wanderer."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I have confidence in the path I'm taking.
However—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There are times when I wonder,
"Is this really okay?
Am I not making a mistake?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Still, now that it's taken on
a tangible form like a trophy—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain of it. The path we chose
wasn't wrong after all.

A special study abroad program with little precedent.
However, the selection committee seemed to recognize
the value of being a trailblazer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer.
About where to place the trophy we received...
choice_data_list: Want to take it back to the room?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No, let's keep it here in the Trainer's office. And then—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "If we ever lose our way, let us gaze upon it together. As a guidepost to reexamine our path."

And so, our memorable Junior-class trophy
was placed on display in the trainer's office.
